causality_tests.failure_condition: Any prefix score or target changes.
causality_tests.name: future_append_corruption_truncation
causality_tests.procedure: Append, corrupt, and remove rows strictly after the lagged cutoff, then compare exact persisted A5 boundary bytes and target mappings.

causality_tests.failure_condition: Input order changes score bytes, membership, or targets.
causality_tests.name: deterministic_order
causality_tests.procedure: Reverse symbol order and every price-row order under seed 20260801.

causality_tests.failure_condition: The A5 boundary input reads, accepts, or serializes an outcome label.
causality_tests.name: label_free_a5_score_boundary
causality_tests.procedure: Place opaque poison objects under auxiliary outcome-like keys and require identical exact persisted A5 boundary bytes.

causality_tests.failure_condition: Missing, duplicate, nonfinite, off-grid, or wrong-close-time data enters a score.
causality_tests.name: availability_membership
causality_tests.procedure: Inject each malformed state and require symbol exclusion or fail-closed flat when fewer than 24 complete symbols remain.

decision_contract.insufficient_scheduled: empty mapping requests flat after exactly one score_boundary({}) call
decision_contract.off_grid: empty mapping requests flat with no score_boundary call and no A5 score artifact row
decision_contract.off_grid_score_boundary: forbidden because the timestamp is outside the manifest schedule
decision_contract.rebalance_rule: nonnegative integer 8h index from the literal 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z anchor modulo 6 equals zero
decision_contract.schedule_anchor_status: actual immutable 48h schedule authority, not an event-timestamp placeholder
decision_contract.scheduled_empty_score_boundary: A5 accepts and captures the empty dict but emits no replay score rows for that timestamp; Team 04's separate schedule-coverage gate fails the reference

derived_features.availability: 63 exact baseline returns followed by 9 exact shock returns through the lagged cutoff
derived_features.missing_rule: Require all 73 exact positive closes, exact 8h close times, and sigma>=1e-6; no fill or substitution. Extra malformed rows are ignored, while two or more valid rows for one expected open invalidate the symbol.

derived_features.formula: exact average rank of raw mapped to [-1,1]
derived_features.missing_rule: Flat when fewer than 24 complete symbols or rank construction is invalid.

derived_features.availability: finite ranked scores at a scheduled boundary
derived_features.formula: K=max(8,floor(3N/10)); top K long, bottom K short; equal 0.24 side budgets and 0.03 cap
derived_features.missing_rule: Flat if sleeve, cap, gross, or net invariant fails.

forbidden_inputs: funding, mark price, OHLC shape, volume, order flow, or order book
common-market factor, beta, residual, or regime label
position, fill, fee, slippage, equity, drawdown, or PnL
forward label or outcome passed through context auxiliary
private/final observations, V1 results, other teams, ballots, or leaderboards

forward_diagnostic.aggregate: one ordinary Pearson correlation across the union of the six disjoint retained fold pools
forward_diagnostic.boundary_output: organizer-captured exact finite ranked score dictionary after ranking and before sleeve selection; a scheduled flat captures an empty dict and contributes no replay score rows
forward_diagnostic.embargo: 30 calendar days for any later outcome-selected candidate
forward_diagnostic.endpoint_rule: Require exactly one finite positive organizer executable open for the emitted symbol at t and t+48h; exit-fold eligibility is not required, but executable endpoint availability is.
forward_diagnostic.fold_assignment: Assign a pair to fold k only when t and t+48h both lie inside that fold's development evaluation interval; purge boundary-crossing pairs and never reuse a pair across folds.
forward_diagnostic.fold_statistic: ordinary Pearson correlation across every retained decision-symbol pair in the fold; no label ranking, timestamp demeaning, timestamp-level averaging, weighting, or Fisher transform
forward_diagnostic.label: simple return executable_open[t+48h,symbol]/executable_open[t,symbol]-1
forward_diagnostic.malformed_or_missing: A duplicate (open_time,symbol) anywhere in the executable-open panel aborts the entire A5 diagnostic before pairing. A missing/delisted, wrong-timestamp, nonfinite, or nonpositive expected endpoint omits that pair and increments the aggregate unavailable-symbol-label count. A5 rejects nonfinite scores before artifact creation, and downstream nonfinite Pearson inputs abort. Never impute, clip, substitute a terminal loss, or use closes.
forward_diagnostic.pair_universe: symbols with a finite score persisted by A5 at scheduled t and valid endpoints
forward_diagnostic.required: aggregate IC>0, fold IC>0 in at least four of six folds, every minimum met, runtime confirmation of one capture per scheduled decision, and Team 04 schedule-coverage confirmation that every scheduled timestamp contributes at least one replay score row
forward_diagnostic.scheduled_empty_record: Frozen A5 captures {} and emits no replay score rows; this is valid adapter behavior but fails Team 04's separately audited research gate, not an automatic A5 qualification gate.
forward_diagnostic.unavailable: Any failed minimum, zero variance, nonfinite correlation, malformed pair membership, or missing A5 evidence fails the reference.

raw_inputs.coverage: organizer-streamed 8h transaction bars for current eligible symbols
raw_inputs.missing_rule: Exact contiguous history only. Ignore rows that fail the expected-open/finite-positive/exact-close-time predicate; invalidate the symbol when more than one row passes that predicate for an expected open.

raw_inputs.availability_timestamp: current decision after weekly causal reconstitution
raw_inputs.coverage: point-in-time Top-40 intersected with executable symbols
